verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents an official Snowflake CLI that lets developers create, manage, update, and view apps across Streamlit, Native Apps, Snowpark Container Services, and Snowpark, with a migration path from the older SnowSQL. A probe confirms the official CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: evidence of AI- or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), detail on command coverage beyond app workloads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: With Snowflake CLI, developers can create, manage, update, and view apps running on Snowflake across workloads such as Streamlit in Snowflake, the Snowflake Native App Framework, Snowpark Container Services, and Snowpark.
If you already use SnowSQL, see Migrating from SnowSQL to Snowflake CLI.
